Definition: a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self)
BiblicalUsage: 1) kidneys; 1a) of physical organ (lit.); 1b) of seat of emotion and affection (fig.); 1c) of sacrificial animals; 2) (TWOT) reins
